items.html: And the matter is that we already explained that in the First Temple they were face to face up above, in the sixth aspect, and the five [Sefirot] illuminated in her; and then she is called “the moon in its completeness,” in the fullness of the moon on the fifteenth of the month, in the secret of fifteen: the Hey upon the Yud, as above. It is found that when they are there above, she is also called the upper Hey. But in the Second Temple, when on weekdays she was face to face in his four lower [Sefirot], and she was the fifth to them, then she is called the lower Hey.
